research.title: The return of Shai-Hulud: How SonarQube detects and contains the npm worm
research.summary: Here we go again. A fresh wave of the self-propagating Shai-Hulud worm is surging through the npm ecosystem. Its goal now is the same as it was with every prior wave: steal developer and CI credentials, then use those credentials to republish itself inside.
